entities.name: Rise of Love Marriage
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Enlightenment and Romantic movement transformed marriage from an economic arrangement to an emotional bond. By 1900, "love matches" were the norm in the West. This was revolutionary — for most of human history, marrying for love was considered foolish or dangerous.
